d:
Yukren yuddh jari hai aur dron teknolji tezi se jang ki ruprekha badal rahi hai. lekin jab mashinen jivan aur maut ka faisla karne lagengi, tab kya hoga?
Ham us aakhiri “kilar dron” ke kitne qarib hain, jo bina insani dakhal ke khud target chunkar use tabah kar sake? kya farq parta hai ki maut insan ke hathon ho ya mashin se? kya is teknolji ko jang ke maidan tak simit rakha ja sakta hai, ya yah hamari rozmarra ki zindgi men bhi ghus jaegi? yah film dikhati hai ki dron teknolji yuddh ko kaise badal rahi hai.
